El puntaje de un pilar es el promedio si: A pillar's score is the simple average of its normalized indicators, excluding those without data. The IIIF is the weighted average of the six pillars, with about 17% each by default. Adjustable weights are redistributed to add up to 100%.
Referencia BIS Red Book 2024 por habitan: BIS Red Book 2024 reference per inhabitant: Brazil 298, Korea 189, Argentina 149, Japan 17, France 9. The BIS measures per inhabitant and the Observatory per adult. Instant payments are 49% of cashless payments in emerging economies and about 10% in advanced ones.
Cada indicador se lleva a una escala de: Each indicator is scaled from 0 to 100 with min max across the six countries. If higher is better: 100 × (value − min) ÷ (max − min). If lower is better: 100 × (max − value) ÷ (max − min). The best observed country gets 100 and the worst 0. Scores are relative to the group.
Las cifras provienen de las fuentes públ: Figures come from the public sources cited. Indices marked as the Observatory's are its own constructions documented in the methodology.
